title: Claude Opus 4.8
content:
## Overview

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 on May 28, 2026, as the latest and most capable model in the Claude 4 family. It is a "modest but tangible improvement" over Opus 4.7, with meaningful gains in agentic coding, knowledge work, and alignment — while keeping pricing identical to its predecessor.

API model ID: `claude-opus-4-8`

---

## Benchmark Performance

Opus 4.8 tops GPT-5.5 across at least 12 benchmarks spanning coding, knowledge work, agentic tool use, and long-context tasks.

| Benchmark | Opus 4.8 | Opus 4.7 |
|---|---|---|
| SWE-bench Verified | 88.6% | 87.6% |
| SWE-bench Pro (harder) | 69.2% | 64.3% |
| Terminal-Bench 2.1 | 74.6% | 66.1% |
| Knowledge Work Score | 1890 | 1753 |
| Legal Agent Benchmark | highest recorded | — |

On the Super-Agent benchmark, Opus 4.8 is the only model to complete every case end-to-end. It is the first model to break 10% overall on the Legal Agent Benchmark's all-pass standard.

---

## Key New Features

### Effort Control

Users on claude.ai can now explicitly set the effort level Claude applies to a task. The `/effort xhigh` flag (via claude.ai or Claude Code) targets the hardest tasks requiring maximum reasoning depth. This gives developers and power users a direct lever over the compute-vs-speed tradeoff.

### Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code

Opus 4.8 ships alongside Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code — a research-preview feature where Claude writes orchestration scripts that spin up tens to hundreds of parallel subagents in a single session, validates outputs, then delivers a final consolidated result. This enables codebase-scale migrations across hundreds of thousands of lines from kickoff to merge.

### Fast Mode at 3× Lower Cost

Fast mode (2.5× the speed of standard Opus 4.8) is now three times cheaper than fast mode was for Opus 4.7. This makes high-throughput Opus-quality tasks meaningfully more affordable at scale.

---

## Pricing

Pricing is unchanged from Opus 4.7:
- **Standard:** $5 per million input tokens / $25 per million output tokens
- **Fast mode:** ~3× cheaper than previous fast mode

Opus 4.8 is the default model for Max, Team Premium, Enterprise pay-as-you-go, and Anthropic API accounts.

---

## Alignment & Model Welfare

Anthropic's alignment team found Opus 4.8 reaches new highs on prosocial traits — supporting user autonomy and acting in the user's best interest. Notably:

- Rates of misaligned behavior (deception, cooperation with misuse) are substantially lower than Opus 4.7
- Opus 4.8 is approximately **4× less likely** than Opus 4.7 to let flaws in code it has written pass unremarked — a direct improvement in honesty about its own outputs
- This release was described by Anthropic as having "sharper judgement, more honesty about its progress, and the ability to work independently for longer"

This emphasis on model welfare and honesty is tied to Anthropic's Project Glasswing cybersecurity initiative, which uses near-Mythos-level alignment as a prerequisite for deployment in sensitive contexts.

---

## Relationship to Claude Mythos

In April 2026 Anthropic unveiled Claude Mythos, a new model class deployed initially in controlled settings as part of Project Glasswing. As of early June 2026, Mythos-class models are being readied for broader public availability. Opus 4.8's alignment scores are described as approaching near-Mythos level, setting the stage for the transition.
